data.name: Salt Cured 50' Yacht
data.headline: Up to 13 Passengers
data.description:
**Experience Luxury on the Water:** Rent a 50ft Yacht with Captain, Ice, Bluetooth Speakers, and Cooler Included!

Indulge in an unforgettable day of luxury and relaxation aboard our stunning 50ft yacht, available for private charters. Perfect for groups of up to 13, this yacht offers ample space and amenities to ensure a memorable experience on the water.
data.highlights:
- **Private Parties:** Celebrate birthdays, anniversaries, or any special occasion in style.
- **Family Outings:** Create lasting memories with your loved ones on a fun-filled day at sea.
- **Corporate Events:** Impress your clients or reward your employees with a unique and luxurious experience.
- **Relaxing Getaways:** Escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and unwind in the serene surroundings of the open water.
data.what_is_included:
- **Spacious and Luxurious Yacht:** Enjoy the comfort and elegance of our well-maintained 50ft yacht, featuring spacious deck, comfortable seating, cabins, and great sound system

- **Experienced Captain:** Our skilled and friendly captain will ensure a safe and enjoyable journey, navigating you to the best spots and catering to your needs.

- **Ice:** Stay refreshed throughout your trip with plenty of ice provided for your beverages.

- **Bluetooth Speakers:** Set the mood and enjoy your favorite tunes with our onboard Bluetooth speakers. Connect your device and create the perfect soundtrack for your day on the water.

- **Cooler for Drinks and Food:** Keep your refreshments chilled and easily accessible with our provided cooler. Bring your own snacks and drinks, or we can arrange catering (ask us about add-ons).


We also offer Jet Ski Rental & Jet Car Deliveries to the boat to enhance your experience.
data.cancellation_summary: Boat will go out rain or shine with exception of NON Sea worthy cond
data.booking_notes:
#Salt Cured 50'

#Address: 
2215 NW 14th St
Miami, FL  33125 USA

##Boat Coordinator: Livan Argote 
+1 (305) 985-8469

---

##Confirmation:
***SeaRay 50’ Yacht***

###What to Expect

- Professional U.S. Coast Guard Licensed Captain
- Freshly Iced and Water Cooler
- 18’ Water Matt and Floaters
- Bring comfortable swimwear, sunscreen, towels, charger, etc.
- USCGA life vests and safety equipment on board

---

###Here is some info that I hope will answer any questions you may have. 

Please try and arrive a half hour early as we have sign coast guard documents and get you guys comfortable on the yacht. Safety first.

The crew and yacht will be ready for you for the start of your contracted time. The yacht runs on a tight schedule and adjusting start times is not an option. Please try and arrive early. 

The captain will address all of your guests about safety first. It’s real important that everyone is paying attention. We take the safety of our guests very seriously. 

Federal Law limits the maximum amount of guests allowed on a Recreational Bareboat Charter is 13. Kids count towards the total of 13. The captain and crew DO NOT count. Please make sure we don’t have more than 13 as there are no exceptions. 

Everyone must remove their shoes while onboard the yacht. 

Some smoking is permitted on the yacht. Cigarettes, Cigars, Wacky tabaky is ok as long as the guests are using a small cup for the ashes. Hookahs are NOT allowed on the yacht (no exceptions). Vapes are okay. 

Use of the bathroom is allowed but you must dispose of toilet paper and / or personal hygiene products in the waste basket provided. A crew member will assist you with flushing the toilet. 

The yacht has a Bluetooth surround sound system for your enjoyment. A crew member will assist you in getting you connected. Once connected we will set the stereo at a safe volume. If the volume needs to be adjusted a crew member will assist you.

The front master bedroom and bathroom are off limits to the guests as we have the owner’s personal belongings in there along with necessary documentation for the coast guard. The door has a sign that reads crew only no entry. Please respect the privacy of the owner. 

We provide you with some ice and water for hydration. Please make sure you bring with you whatever you wish to eat and drink. Please make sure you bring cups and plates if you feel you will need them. 

We will have a nice cruise from the historic Miami River to the anchorage area. We will be at the anchorage area for approximately 2 hours. You will then have the option to jump in the water, enjoy our floating Lili pad, or rent Jet Skis. If you wish to rent Jet Skis please let the captain know and he can reserve them. 

If you have a balance remaining to be paid, the captain will collect it when your signing the coast guard documents on board the yacht. The balance must be paid in full before the yacht can leave the docks.

We accept the following forms of payment. 
Cash
Zelle
Cashapp 
Venmo
ApplePay 

The total amount that you have paid for your charter does not include any gratuity / tip for the crew. If The Captain and First Mate do a great job ensuring your safety, comfort, & enjoyment. Please show your gratitude by tipping accordingly. Thank you!

When you arrive PLEASE contact the captain and he will greet you at the main marina entrance door.

(If captains name and phone number is not in this confirmation, the captain will call you 24 hours prior to the day of the reservation.)
data.extras:
- Flexible Rental Options: Choose from half-day, full-day, or multi-day charters to suit your schedule and preferences.
- Customizable Itineraries: We can work with you to create a personalized itinerary that meets your specific needs and interests.
- Catering Options: We can arrange for catering services to provide delicious meals and beverages onboard, or you are welcome to bring your own
